text:
Sora: quick check  compact legend + smoothing interaction on the metrics page. Users said items disappear and keyboard users can't reach the hidden ones. need an accessible affordance that doesn't move layout.

Eli: saw that. idea: keep fixed legend height, show a subtle fade at the bottom, and a single "Show all" control that reveals remaining items inline (no DOM reorder). button should be in tab order.

Aisha: accessibility notes: the "Show all" must have aria-controls pointing to the legend list id, and an aria-live update: 'Legend collapsed: 3 items hidden'. When expanded: 'Legend expanded: 6 items visible'. Also use roving tabindex inside the legend to keep tab stops small.

Ben: microcopy ideas for the button: "Show all" / "Expand legend" / "More series". my vote: "Show all" is shortest and clear. tooltip: "Show all series" for clarity.

Sora: visual hint: gradient fade + a compact button anchored to the border. keep contrast high and ensure focus ring meets 4.5:1. example CSS: .legend-fade { height: 28px; background: linear-gradient(transparent, var(--bg)); } .legend-more:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus); }

Eli: implement so expanding simply toggles a "collapsed=false" class that reveals hidden items with a max-height transition. respect prefers-reduced-motion (no transition).

Aisha: SR behavior: after expand, move focus into the first newly revealed item or keep focus on the "Show all" button and announce count. preference: keep focus on the button and announce via polite aria-live: 'Legend expanded: 3 additional series now visible'. avoids focus surprise.

Ben: edge-case: when smoothing changes which series are visible, announce both changes: 'Chart updated: smoothing enabled; legend collapsed: 2 items hidden'. include numbers so screen reader users know scale changed.

Sora: tests: visual snapshot for collapsed vs expanded; keyboard test for tab flow; aria-live message snapshot. Eli will add test stubs.

Eli: i'll open a draft PR with a prototype and tests. ETA tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
